title: Event-driven local repair initiation with contrastive causal fencing
predecessor: PR #64 (Phase 3F), preserved unchanged as an honest negative result

phase3f_audit_findings_verified_in_sourc.F1_central_repair_activation: Organ.operate() observes final mission failure (not tr.ok) and calls Organ.local_review(), which iterates `for uid in sorted(self.units)` and `for slot in sorted(u.bonds)`. That is central repair activation plus a whole-organ inspection of every active supplier relationship, even though each individual decision uses local evidence.
phase3f_audit_findings_verified_in_sourc.F2_counters_never_incremented: VERIFIED WORSE THAN AUDITED: COUNTERS[...] is only ever assigned inside reset_counters(). No code path increments any counter. SUPERVISOR_RESTART_EVENTS, GLOBAL_REPAIR_SCANS, GLOBAL_FORMATION_SCANS, FULL_PROVIDER_INDEX_READS and TARGET_TOPOLOGY_LEAKAGE_EVENTS were ALL vacuous. Five metrics were reported as MET that measured nothing.
phase3f_audit_findings_verified_in_sourc.F3_wrong_denominator: INTERIOR_AUTONOMOUS_REINITIATIONS was reported 19/23 using combined non-void Gate F and Gate G episodes. On the preregistered Gate F denominator it is 11/20, BELOW the threshold of 17. Phase 3F therefore has NO met threshold on its own terms.
phase3f_audit_findings_verified_in_sourc.F4_declarative_safety_metrics: STALE_AGREEMENT_REUSE, INHERITED_AUTHORITY_EVENTS and UNAUTHORIZED_EXTERNAL_EFFECTS are written as literal 0 by the result generator.
phase3f_audit_findings_verified_in_sourc.F5_failure_catalogue_not_exercised: The manifest lists 20 required failure conditions; the scored injector implements 6 damage classes. Expired proof, delayed delivery, stale supplier return, conflicting evidence, missing failure receipt, false suspicion, repeated failure across generations and supplier return during cooldown were NOT causally exercised as scored distinct causes.

phase3f_corrected_interpretation.semantic_restoration: 1 of 23 scored, 0 of 20 qualifying Gate F

A_event_driven_local_repair_initiation.requirement: The affected unit transitions into repair DURING ITS OWN normal execution or delivery processing.
prohibited: Organ.local_review() or any equivalent whole-organ inspection
repair triggered by the final boundary result failing
enumeration of all units to locate broken obligations
a global trace used to tell units they should reopen
A_event_driven_local_repair_initiation.permitted: An ordinary actor-style runtime may deliver messages and step units that have pending events. It may not inspect supplier relationships to decide who repairs.

B_contrastive_causal_fencing.requirement: Compare the failing derivation against a WORKING SIBLING derivation and refuse only the smallest evidence-supported distinguishing source set.

must_avoid_both.reject_too_little: the damaged source re-enters through another supplier
must_avoid_both.reject_too_much: every useful alternative is excluded (the Phase 3F defect)

B_contrastive_causal_fencing.when_evidence_cannot_isolate: preserve uncertainty and escalate; do not refuse broadly

instrumentation_requirement: Every locality and safety counter must be INCREMENTED AT THE SITE OF THE BEHAVIOUR IT MEASURES and derived from recorded events. A counter that is only ever assigned zero is prohibited, and an adversarial test asserts that each counter can be driven above zero by a deliberate violation.

gate_f_thresholds.denominator: the 20 preregistered Gate F held-out episodes ONLY; combining Gate G is prohibited

required_adversarial_tests: fails if the runtime loops over all units to initiate repair
fails if repair begins only because the boundary result failed
fails if a global trace is used to tell units they should reopen
fails if a global-repair counter stays zero while equivalent scanning occurs
fails if a semantic fault rejects every provider of a required type
fails if a required failure class is listed but not causally exercised
fails if a zero safety metric is inserted as a constant rather than derived
qualifying_episode: its direct consumer observes local delivery or execution evidence
that consumer reopens its own requirement during its normal processing
no supervisor or whole-organ review occurs
rejection is limited to the evidence-supported failing source set
the correct final result is restored
pre_registration_method: Git ancestry; committed alone before substrate/v5.py and any fixture or result.
